lead: An option bag's value may be a variable, and a `uint` parameter accepts an integer literal at the call site.
body: `Core\Arr::from($c, {limit: $limit})` lowers with `$limit` a `uint` parameter, so a swept bound does not need one call site per value, and `Drive::at(0)` against `public static function at(uint $limit)` needs no `as uint`. The brace literal is an expression like any other — only its keys are fixed by the member's row.
